subject: Re: Charformer JAX port — kickoff
body:
Status on the port.

Parity: reached on the base config. Our FLAX GBST layer matches the Mesh-TF reference (the cf_v2_d3_dv_base.gin config) to within float tolerance on forward pass, and end-to-end training curves overlap after 50k steps. The fiddly part was replicating how the reference injects the gradient-subword layers right after the positional embeddings and loops them before the layer stack — order matters more than the paper lets on.

Trainer integration (Milan): done for single-host, multi-host sharding in review.

Risk for the record: at char-level sequence lengths our attention memory blows up ~3.5x vs subword baseline at equal batch. GBST's downsampling recovers most of it but not all; Yara's eval runs will need gradient checkpointing on, which costs ~20% step time. Doesn't threaten the window, does affect Q3 sweep sizing.

Wei
